new.s: Lyudmila Viktorovna Khokhlova of Russia received the Padma Shri 2026 in:
new.x: Khokhlova was honoured in Literature and Education.

new.s: Who received the 59th Jnanpith Award (2024)?
new.x: Vinod Kumar Shukla (Hindi) won the 59th; Vairamuthu the 60th and Gulzar shared the 58th.

new.s: The Jnanpith Award carries a cash prize of:
new.x: The Jnanpith carries ₹11 lakh, a citation and a bronze statue of Vagdevi.

new.s: R. Vairamuthu is the ____ Tamil winner of the Jnanpith Award.
new.x: Vairamuthu is the 3rd Tamil Jnanpith winner.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Jnanpith Award:
1. It is given by Bharatiya Jnanpith.
2. It is for Indian citizens writing in Eighth Schedule languages and English.
3. Nobel laureate Amartya Sen is a recipient.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct; Amartya Sen is not a Jnanpith recipient, as the award is for Indian literature.

new.s: Viswanatha Satyanarayana, the first Telugu Jnanpith winner (1970), was honoured for:
new.x: Viswanatha won for Ramayana Kalpavrukshamu; Viswambhara was C. Narayana Reddy's and Paakudu Raallu Ravuri Bharadwaja's.

new.s: In the Sahitya Akademi Awards 2025, the only autobiography was in which language?
new.x: The only autobiography was Marathi; the only literary criticism was Tamil.

new.s: Boyi Bhimanna received the Sahitya Akademi Award (1975) for:
new.x: Boyi Bhimanna won for Gudisale Kalipotunnayi; he also received the Padma Shri (1973) and Padma Bhushan (2001).

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Telugu Sahitya Akademi winners:
1. Gurram Jashuva received the Sahitya Akademi Award for Gabbilam.
2. Penugonda Lakshminarayana won in 2024 for Deepika (Literary Criticism).
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Only statement 2 is correct; Gurram Jashuva was not awarded for Gabbilam.

new.s: Who is the President of the Sahitya Akademi?
new.x: Madhav Kaushik heads the Sahitya Akademi, which is under the Ministry of Culture.

new.s: The Sahitya Akademi was formally inaugurated on:
new.x: Set up by a resolution of 15 December 1952, it was inaugurated on 12 March 1954; first awards came in 1955.

new.s: Who won Best Actor at the 98th Academy Awards?
new.x: Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor for Sinners; Sean Penn won Best Supporting Actor.

new.s: Which film won Best International Feature at the 98th Academy Awards?
new.x: Sentimental Value won Best International Feature; Mr. Nobody Against Putin won Documentary Feature.

new.s: The Academy Awards were first held in:
new.x: The Oscars were first held in 1929; the name 'Oscar' was adopted in 1939.

new.s: Who hosted the 96th Academy Awards (2024) for the fourth time?
new.x: Jimmy Kimmel hosted the 96th Oscars, at which Oppenheimer won Best Picture.

new.s: Who won the first Golden Globe in the new Best Podcast category?
new.x: Amy Poehler won the first Best Podcast award for 'Good Hang with Amy Poehler'.

new.s: The BAFTA trophy is shaped like a:
o: Knight with a sword on a film reel
new.x: The BAFTA trophy is a theatrical mask; the Oscar is a knight with a sword on a film reel.

new.s: Boong, the first Indian winner of BAFTA's Children's & Family Film award, is a ____ film.
new.x: Boong is a Manipuri film written and directed by Lakshmipriya Devi.

new.s: Who received the BAFTA Fellowship at the 79th BAFTA Film Awards?
new.x: Donna Langley got the Fellowship; Clare Binns received the Outstanding British Contribution to Cinema award.

new.s: At the Gaddar Telangana Film Awards 2025, who received the Raghupathi Venkaiah Award?
new.x: Ramesh Prasad got the Raghupathi Venkaiah Award; Chiranjeevi got the NTR National Award.

new.s: Who received the NTR National Award at the Gaddar Telangana Film Awards 2025?
new.x: Chiranjeevi received the NTR National Award.

new.s: Which film won the National Integration award at the Gaddar Telangana Film Awards 2025?
new.x: Thandel won National Integration; Raju Weds Rambayi was Best Film.

new.s: Parakram Diwas, on which the Aapda Prabandhan Puraskar is announced, was declared in:
new.x: 23 January was declared Parakram Diwas in 2021; the Puraskar was first conferred in 2019.

new.s: The individual winner of the Subhash Chandra Bose Aapda Prabandhan Puraskar receives:
new.x: The individual gets ₹5 lakh and the institution ₹51 lakh, each with a certificate.

new.s: Who handed over the INA to Subhas Chandra Bose on 4 July 1943?
new.x: Rash Behari Bose handed the INA to Netaji on 4 July 1943.

new.s: Ross Island was renamed Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose Island in:
new.x: Ross Island was renamed in 2018.

new.s: Which of the following pairs (70th Filmfare Awards South) is correctly matched?
new.x: Amitabh Bachchan won Supporting Actor for Kalki 2898 AD; Critics' Best Actor was Teja Sajja, Music Album Devi Sri Prasad and Critics' Best Actress Kajal Aggarwal.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Crawford Prize?
o: Its ceremony is held in Stockholm in May
It is awarded by the Nobel Committee
new.x: The Crawford Prize is given by the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences, not the Nobel Committee.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Telangana Governor Awards for Excellence 2025:
1. They were presented on 26 January at Lok Bhavan by Governor Jishnu Dev Varma.
2. They were instituted in 2024 and carry ₹2 lakh each.

new.x: Both are correct: the awards, instituted in 2024 with ₹2 lakh each, were presented on 26 January at Lok Bhavan.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about persons who died in early 2026?

Hugh Gantzer was a Padma Shri 2025 awardee
David J. Farber died in Hyderabad
new.x: David J. Farber, the 'grandfather of the internet', died in Tokyo, not Hyderabad.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about BIOFACH 2026?
o: It was held in Nuremberg, Germany
India was its 'Country of the Year' after 14 years
India's pavilion was coordinated by APEDA
The APEDA Act came into effect on 13 February 1985
new.x: The APEDA Act was passed in December 1985 and came into effect on 13 February 1986.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about appointments in February 2026:

2. Deepak Gupta became CMD of GAIL from 1 March 2026.

new.x: Both are correct: Nidhi Chhibber succeeded B.V.R. Subrahmanyam at NITI Aayog and Deepak Gupta took over GAIL from 1 March 2026.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Sakharov Prize:
1. It was established in 1988.
2. Its ceremony is held in Strasbourg.
3. It is named after Andrei Sakharov.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: All three are correct: the European Parliament's prize was set up in 1988, is named after Andrei Sakharov and is presented in Strasbourg.

new.s: Which of the following pairs about Vithalbhai Patel is correctly matched?
o: 1933 – President of the Central Legislative Assembly
new.x: He co-founded the Swaraj Party in 1923; he entered the Bombay Council in 1912 and the Imperial Council in 1918, became Assembly President in 1925 and died in 1933.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Padma Shri awardee Prof. K. L. Krishna?
o: He trained under C.R. Rao at ISI
He did his PhD at the University of Chicago
He was founding editor of the Journal of Quantitative Economics
He led the India KLEMS project at IIT Delhi
new.x: He led the India KLEMS productivity project at the Delhi School of Economics, not IIT Delhi.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the 2025 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine:
1. Shimon Sakaguchi discovered regulatory T cells in 1995.
2. Brunkow and Ramsdell identified the gene FOXP3 in 2001.

new.x: Both are correct: Sakaguchi found T-regs (1995) and Brunkow and Ramsdell identified FOXP3 (2001).

K-Pop Demon Hunters won Best International Feature

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Jnanpith Award?

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose:
1. He hoisted the Tricolour at Port Blair on 30 December 1943.
